# Jason Hill

Jason C. Hill is an automotive designer who worked for Mattel around 2005, likely on a subcontractor basis. He is the founder of Eleven, an automotive design consultancy, which he has run since 2003. Prior to his work at Eleven, Hill worked for Hyundai, Porsche and ill-fated automotive company Aptera Motors as a designer; he was also the lead designer of the Porsche Carrera GT Concept showcased in 2000, working alongside noted automotive designer Harm Lagaay.
